page.content:
Conglomerate the family kills over — army, labs, and the tournament.

How Mishima Zaibatsu connects

  • Character: Heihachi Mishima — Heihachi Mishima was the long-running patriarch of the Mishima Zaibatsu.
  • Event: King of Iron Fist Tournament — The Mishima Zaibatsu hosts the King of Iron Fist Tournament.
  • Topic: Tekken — The Mishima Zaibatsu is the company the Tekken saga wars over.
  • Faction: Tekken Force — Tekken Force is the Mishima Zaibatsu's private army.
  • Character: Jin Kazama — Jin later seized the Mishima Zaibatsu and declared war on the world.
  • Location: Hon-Maru — Hon-Maru is the Mishima family's temple compound.
  • Faction: G Corporation — G Corporation is Kazuya's corporate rival to the Mishima Zaibatsu.
  • Character: Lee Chaolan — Lee Chaolan was adopted into the Mishima Zaibatsu as Kazuya's rival.
  • Character: Nina Williams — Nina has taken Mishima Zaibatsu contracts across several tournaments.
  • Character: Yoshimitsu — Yoshimitsu steals from the Mishima Zaibatsu to fund the Manji Clan.

What is Mishima Zaibatsu?

The Mishima Zaibatsu is the multinational that hosts the King of Iron Fist Tournament. Heihachi, Kazuya, and Jin have each seized it, turning a company into a private army.

Key threads lead to Heihachi Mishima, King of Iron Fist Tournament, Tekken, Tekken Force, Jin Kazama and Hon-Maru.
